text: National Science, Technology and Innovation Policy has mandate to contribute in the vision of "Atmanirbhar Bharat". Elaborate the role of the policy with respect to making India as World's Technology and Service hub.

2017 has been declared as the International Year of Sustainable Tourism for development. In this context, discuss the initiatives taken by the Government of Andhra Pradesh for promotion of tourism. What additional steps may be taken to sustain tourism as an industry?
There is a marked shift in India's foreign policy initiatives under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Discuss the important changes and developments.

After reorganisation, the State of Andhra Pradesh is without a separate capital. The Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh envisages a world class city. While analysing the progress so far in realising the goal, evaluate Amaravathi as a "city for all".
India is called the "surrogacy hub" of the World. Can commercial surrogacy be seen just as another industry? Evaluate in light of the bill regulating surrogacy pending before the Parliament.
How do you assess the global terrorism and intervention of US in the internal affairs of Afghanistan and Pakistan?
"The London riots of last year (August, 2011) exposed a widespread disillusionment with the establishment." - Explain the statement in the light of the growing economic crisis in Europe.
Evaluate the health programmes in Andhra Pradesh with a focus on the working of 'Rajiv Arogya Sree' Scheme.
Explain the inclusive higher education and the role of Fee Reimbursement Scheme in Andhra Pradesh.

Reality shows have become a major part of the prime time television. They are influencing mindset of numerous households making them believe and live in a hypothetical world. State the effect of reality shows on our society.
The relations of India with the ASEAN countries is part of the "Look East Policy'. Does the same hold good with the Indo-EU relations? Do they follow "Look West Policy'? Elucidate.

There are a variety of public-private partnerships models on which the government relies upon. Explain various models with illustrations. Comment on the PPP model in Rajiv Gandhi International Airport at Hyderabad.
Explain the history, governance and politics of the European Union.
Discuss the importance of Indo-US nuclear agreement. Analyse the causes for its opposition, and state whether Hyde Act curtails India's independence in foreign policy.
Write an essay on the recent achievement of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) which has launched 10 satellites by PSLV-C9.
Is economic development a panacea for overcoming social inequality? Comment.
'In India the economic inequalities and regional disparities increased in the process of Liberalisation, Privatisation and Globalisation.' Discuss.
"The uneven development has led to the growth of regionalism in India.' Discuss
"Most of India's college graduates are unemployable," said ex-President Pranab Mukherjee, during his tenure. The crisis in higher education needs to be addressed through policy measures. Comment.
Regional disparity is one of the key factors for demand of bifurcation of States in India. In light of this, how can balanced regional development be ensured in the State of Andhra Pradesh?
"Government of India announced special package but did not grant special status to Andhra Pradesh". Explain whether special status would have any advantage over the present special package?

"Despite huge gains in economic output, our current social, political and economic systems are exacerbating inequalities, rather than reducing them". In view of the above statement, discuss the importance of inclusive growth?
Examine the role of self-help groups (SHGS) and micro finance institutions (MFIs) in meeting the credit requirements of rural people in Andhra Pradesh?

"Primary education is the foundation for empowerment of Children". Discuss the impact on the democratic rights of the children and discrimination between rich and poor children, in light of heavy commercialization of primary education?

Urbanisation can create more opportunities and can erase social hierarchies. However, a massive move towards cities could create major challenges for the policy makers and the administrators. What are these challenges and what are your suggestions to address these challenges?
Write an essay on the crisis in agriculture and farmers suicides in India.

With Portugal, Greece, Italy and Spain staring at a bleak future, the world economic situation can be considered to be in a dire state. With developing economies being highly dependent on their developed counterparts for investments, there will be an effect on stock markets, employment and balance of payments. State your reasons whether or not the developing world will be affected.

The concept of development is pushed down from the top by the MNCs bypassing nation states. This misplaced conception of development is not totally favoured by the states and the people in the developing world for socio-economic and political reasons. Is there a way to integrate or combine the two different conceptions of development of the free market and the individual state?

Discuss the initiatives of the Andhra Pradesh Government with regard to Rashtriya Madhyamik Shiksha Abhiyan (RMSA), a centrally sponsored literacy programme, outlining its objectives, functions and impact.
Write an essay on the implementation and operation of the National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme in Andhra Pradesh.
Discuss the pros and cons of Special Economic Zones (SEZs) in Andhra Pradesh.
Write an essay on the Economic Crisis, Structural Reforms and the Prospects of Growth in India.
Elaborate the role of renewable energy in mitigation of climate change.

In Stephen Hawking's words, "Mankind must move to outer space within a century". In the backdrop of his prediction, what are the factors leading to pessimism in turning around the global environmental degradation? Discuss.

"River linking is a panacea for the woes of farmers of Andhra Pradesh". In light of the above statement, explain how river linking can solve the problem of water scarcity in Andhra Pradesh. Also describe Pattiseema project of Andhra Pradesh and its benefits?
What are global initiatives implemented by the United Nations for sustainable development? Discuss
Critically examine the measures taken by the Indian government for improvement of food security.
What are the aims and objectives of the National Water Policy? How are they reflected in the state water policies? Explain.

With constant rise in global temperatures, greenhouse gases and global sea levels, it is disastrous that climate change talks at Copenhagen between major nations have failed to come to a consensus. Explain why our leaders have failed to come to a mutual understanding for combating climate change.
What is 'Drought'? What are the implications of drought? Discuss the various steps taken by the government in this regard. How do you tackle the problem there is drought continuously for three years?
Is judicial activism distorting separation of powers enshrined in the Indian Constitution? Critically examine citing relevant judicial pronouncements.
Despite Constitutional Guarantees and Policy Initiatives, Social Justice in India faces significant challenges. Examine.
There is a global resurgence of nationalism or right wing. Discuss its implications for democracy and the neo-liberal economic policies.

The Constitution of India provides protection to life and liberty of a citizen. At the same time, growing events of terrorism, naxalism and mob violence, underscore the need for stringent laws for control. Discuss the measures to be taken for striking a balance between both.
Discuss the progress in recent Indian efforts in evolving joint counter terrorism strategy with different allies? What is the implication of current violence in Kashmir Valley on these efforts?
What is the present situation of Dalits in India? Despite numerous developmental schemes and stringent laws for protection, why there is no substantial progress at the ground level?
"Sedition laws have no place in a democracy" - Comment on the above sentence, in the context of the recent conflicts in our country?
Explain "BREXIT"? Discuss its likely impact on governance, politics and economy of European Union?
Write a critical essay on violation of human rights. What measures do you suggest to protect human rights in times of crisis?
Write an essay on 'War on Terror' in the light of 9/11.
Write a critical essay on the existing laws/policies against sexual harassment of women at the workplace.
What does the Indian National Policy for Senior Citizens 2011 reveal about the changing Indian society? Elaborate.
